title: Aurora NDE 6535
content: I was standing out in the yard wrapped in a bed sheet. I had my phone in my hand. I was watching a thunderstorm and the lightening was very intense. The air was dry and the clouds rolled black. I was replying to a text, and as soon as I pressed send, everything stopped. Slow motion and seconds seemed like minutes. I think the whole course of the event only took about a minute but it felt more like ten to fifteen. I could see a white light to my left, like when you stare at a light too long and there's a light from it everywhere you look. I don't think I was breathing and my body felt heavy and I started to lower almost to my knees. Before I hit the ground, I couldn't feel my body and I could see myself from an angle above. It was the strangest thing to look down at yourself. It's the hardest thing to try to describe, but before I saw myself hit the ground, I was shot back in. All I could smell was something burnt and my skin felt electric with constant static. As I regained feeling in my legs, I noticed it was pouring rain outside. As soon as I was able, I ran inside my house and jumped into a chair. My heart was racing and it hurt to breathe and everything I touched I shocked. I had left my phone outside and I'm to guess it's the cause for what happened. Still to this day it's bad for me to touch trampolines or wool, anything with a lot of static because I get a huge shock and its hard touching people sometimes because I shock them.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: She reports she could see herself 'from an angle above.'
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She reports she 'couldn't feel my body' before being 'shot back in.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Lightning/thunderstorm incident while outside holding a phone; she suspects the phone contributed.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Time dilation/slow motion during the event; physical aftereffects (burnt smell, static/electrical skin).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Slow-motion/time dilation and white light occurred before the out-of-body perception; the return happened abruptly before she saw her body hit the ground.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred during a thunderstorm with intense lightning; she perceived a white light to her left and then an abrupt OBE and rapid return, followed by strong electrical/static sensations and ongoing sensitivity to static (shocking objects/people).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Slow motion and seconds seemed like minutes.” “I could see myself from an angle above.” “Before I saw myself hit the ground, I was shot back in.” “my skin felt electric with constant static.”
